# Vaibhav Kothari | Full Stack Engineer

> Personal portfolio of Vaibhav Kothari — Full Stack Engineer, Mobile Developer, and AI Builder. Currently building Sythra (https://sythra.ai). Also takes on freelance engineering work, including for Aistad (https://aistad.com). Features web platforms, cross-platform mobile applications, agentic AI systems, open source contributions, and technical writing.
